goldens.comment: Mixing float: left with flexbox causes layout issues. Further this PR removes the float-based right alignment for .d-header .panel, which may cause the login panel in the non-Ember/noscript header (where .panel is nested inside .row and not a flex item) to stack under the title instead of remaining right-aligned.
goldens.reasoning: C1 identifies the removed float-based right alignment for .panel in the ERB header, where .panel isn't a flex item, which is the core of G1.

goldens.comment: -ms-align-items never existed in any version of IE/Edge; the correct legacy property is -ms-flex-align.
goldens.reasoning: C2 points out the same invalid -ms-align-items property and names -ms-flex-align as the correct one.

goldens.comment: -webkit-box-ordinal-group and -moz-box-ordinal-group require values starting from 1, not 0. If $val is 0, this will cause incorrect rendering in older browsers, leading to layout issues.
goldens.reasoning: None of the candidates mention the box-ordinal-group values needing to start at 1.

candidates: This removes the only right-alignment rule for the ERB header's `.panel`; `margin-left: auto` only works when `.panel` is a flex item, but `_header.html.erb` nests it inside `.row`.

The `align-items` mixin emits `-ms-align-items`, which is not a valid vendor-prefixed CSS property. The correct IE prefix is `-ms-flex-align` (already present in the mixin). The invalid `-ms-align-items` line in the mixin should be removed to avoid confusion.
Keep paragraph spacing inside `.custom-message`; zeroing `p` margins collapses multi-paragraph cooked messages into one block.
